name: Nirvana Residence
label: Above market value
paymentPlan: Flexible payment plans and installment options
overview: Nirvana Residence stands as a testament to thoughtful urban living in the heart of Dubai Production City (IMPZ), representing Meraki Developers' commitment to creating homes that blend luxury with practicality. This recently launched residential development offers discerning buyers an exceptional opportunity to invest in one of Dubai's most dynamic and fastest-growing business and media districts. With starting prices from AED 650,000, Nirvana Residence provides an affordable gateway to premium living in a strategically positioned location that promises both immediate comfort and long-term value appreciation.
